events.help:
Read the derived transcript-event projection (blizzard#255), every ``/events``
filter as a flag: a bounded page by default, or the whole filtered set streamed as
NDJSON to stdout under ``--ndjson``.
events.short_help: Read the derived transcript-event projection (blizzard#255), every ``/events`` filter as a flag: a bounded page by default, or the whole filtered set streamed as NDJSON to stdout under ``--ndjson``.

re-derive.help:
Force the standing derivation sweep's own replacement unit now, rather than
waiting for its next tick — scoped to one segment, one chunk, or every candidate
(neither option given). No downtime: it runs the same in-process reconciler already
live, just driven directly. Prints ``derived``/``remaining``; a nonzero ``remaining``
on a chunk/all-scoped call means running it again continues from where it left off.
re-derive.short_help: Force the standing derivation sweep's own replacement unit now, rather than waiting for its next tick — scoped to one segment, one chunk, or every candidate (neither option given).

summary.help:
Read one of the canned counts or operational-dataset rollups (blizzard#255/#256):
the four DATASET counts (counts-files, counts-skills, counts-agent-types,
counts-nodes) and the six operational datasets (durations-nodes, durations-graphs,
spend-nodes, spend-graphs, spend-chunks, outcomes-nodes). Only spend-chunks pages
or streams; a filter DATASET's own route does not expose is refused.
summary.short_help: Read one of the canned counts or operational-dataset rollups (blizzard#255/#256): the four DATASET counts (counts-files, counts-skills, counts-agent-types, counts-nodes) and the six operational datasets (durations-nodes, durations-graphs, spend-nodes, spend-graphs, spend-chunks, outcomes-nodes).

analytics.help: Operator verbs over derived transcript-event analytics.
analytics.short_help: Operator verbs over derived transcript-event analytics.

delete.help:
Delete unacquired CHUNK, withdrawing every open hub item it holds (issue #364).

A pure client of ``DELETE /api/chunks/{id}``. Irreversible, so confirms first unless
``--yes``. 409 when a runner or a human holds CHUNK, or it is terminal — deletion
needs CHUNK at the same statuses ``group`` does; 404 only when CHUNK is unknown.
delete.short_help: Delete unacquired CHUNK, withdrawing every open hub item it holds (issue #364).

detach.help:
Forcibly release CHUNK from its runner.

A pure client of the hub API: ``POST /api/chunks/{id}/detach``. The chunk re-derives
ready and is re-claimable at its current node; the holding runner releases it on its
next tick. 409 when the chunk has no live route to release.
detach.short_help: Forcibly release CHUNK from its runner.

done.help:
Manually complete CHUNK, from any non-``done`` status, including ``stopped`` (issue #294).
A pure client of ``POST /api/chunks/{id}/complete``. The chunk derives ``done``; any live
route and held hub-exec slot are released in the same operation, and its work refs become
eligible for closure. Idempotent — an already-``done`` chunk is a harmless no-op, never
refused.
done.short_help: Manually complete CHUNK, from any non-``done`` status, including ``stopped`` (issue #294).

group.help:
Merge MERGE_IDS into CHUNK_ID, the survivor.

A pure client of ``POST /api/chunks/{id}/group``: the survivor and every merge id
must currently be **unacquired** — ``not_ready`` or ``ready``, in any mix (409
otherwise). The survivor absorbs the union of work refs and keeps its own status.
group.short_help: Merge MERGE_IDS into CHUNK_ID, the survivor.

ingest.help:
Ingest work items by token, minting a chunk.

Each POINTER is a source-native token — ``source:ref``, ``source#ref``, or a pasted
work item URL; a batch mints one chunk carrying every pointer. 422 when no
configured work source claims a token; 409 when a pointer is already held.
ingest.short_help: Ingest work items by token, minting a chunk.

list.help: The fleet chunk list — derived status per chunk.
list.short_help: The fleet chunk list — derived status per chunk.

migrate.help:
Set, overwrite, or clear CHUNK's standing migration intent (issue #124).

``--node`` present selects ``forced``, absent selects ``auto``; ``--cancel`` clears
a standing intent and conflicts with ``--to-graph``/``--node``. The intent is consulted at
the chunk's next transition, never applied eagerly — ``restart --to-graph`` moves it now.
migrate.short_help: Set, overwrite, or clear CHUNK's standing migration intent (issue #124).

pause.help:
Pause CHUNK — the runner kills and parks the worker but keeps the claim (issue #46).

A pure client of the hub API: ``POST /api/chunks/{id}/pause``. Unlike ``detach``, no
route is released and no retry is consumed. 409 when the chunk is done/stopped/
delivering.
pause.short_help: Pause CHUNK — the runner kills and parks the worker but keeps the claim (issue #46).

pm.help: Deprecated alias for ``blizzard hub chunk work-items`` (issue #55).
pm.short_help: Deprecated alias for ``blizzard hub chunk work-items`` (issue #55).

promote.help:
Promote a not-ready CHUNK to ready so a runner may claim it.

A pure client of the hub API: ``POST /api/chunks/{id}/promote``. Idempotent — promoting
an already-ready chunk is a harmless no-op; 404 only when the chunk is unknown.
promote.short_help: Promote a not-ready CHUNK to ready so a runner may claim it.

requeue.help: Close an escalation by supersession: requeue CHUNK at its current node.
requeue.short_help: Close an escalation by supersession: requeue CHUNK at its current node.

restart.help:
Force CHUNK onto a node now, on a freshly minted session (issues #370, #371).

A pure client of ``POST /api/chunks/{id}/restart``. The move has already happened when the call
returns: the bumped epoch tears the running attempt down and re-enters, where ``migrate`` only
records an intent for the next transition. 409 when CHUNK is terminal or the target refuses it.
restart.short_help: Force CHUNK onto a node now, on a freshly minted session (issues #370, #371).

resume.help:
Resume a paused CHUNK — the runner resumes the parked worker in place (issue #46).

A pure client of the hub API: ``POST /api/chunks/{id}/resume``. Idempotent: resuming
an unpaused chunk is a harmless no-op. 404 only when the chunk is unknown.
resume.short_help: Resume a paused CHUNK — the runner resumes the parked worker in place (issue #46).

set.help:
Repin CHUNK's graph and/or default model/effort in one call (issues #104, #144).

A pure client of ``PATCH /api/chunks/{id}``, naming whichever fields were given and
applied all-or-nothing. At least one option is required; 409 for the defaults once
CHUNK is claimed, and for ``--graph`` once it is claimed or has moved (#271).
set.short_help: Repin CHUNK's graph and/or default model/effort in one call (issues #104, #144).

show.help: One chunk's full aggregate — status, current node, route, pointers, cost.
show.short_help: One chunk's full aggregate — status, current node, route, pointers, cost.

stop.help:
Terminally abandon CHUNK — the operator's last-resort verb (issue #118).

A pure client of ``POST /api/chunks/{id}/stop``. The chunk derives ``stopped`` and
never re-derives ``ready``; any live route is released and any open escalation closed
in the same operation. 409 when already done/stopped. There is no ``un-stop``.
stop.short_help: Terminally abandon CHUNK — the operator's last-resort verb (issue #118).

work-items.help:
CHUNK's work items, pass-through — one entry per work ref, vendor-native.

A pure client of ``GET /api/chunks/{id}/work-items``; a per-pointer forge failure
degrades to that entry's own ``error`` rather than failing the whole read.
work-items.short_help: CHUNK's work items, pass-through — one entry per work ref, vendor-native.

chunk.help: Operator verbs over one chunk: ingest, inspect, edit, and transition it.
chunk.short_help: Operator verbs over one chunk: ingest, inspect, edit, and transition it.

list.help: List open decisions awaiting a human (gate surfacing).
list.short_help: List open decisions awaiting a human (gate surfacing).

resolve.help:
Resolve an open decision by picking CHOICE (first-write-wins).

A pure client of ``POST /api/decisions/{id}/resolutions`` (issue #104's pluralized
resolution route).
resolve.short_help: Resolve an open decision by picking CHOICE (first-write-wins).

decision.help: Operator verbs over open gate decisions: list, resolve.
decision.short_help: Operator verbs over open gate decisions: list, resolve.

confirm-gone.help: Confirm by hand that FINDING_IDS no longer reproduce.
confirm-gone.short_help: Confirm by hand that FINDING_IDS no longer reproduce.

list.help:
List ROUTINE's findings under SCOPE — live only, unless --include-gone, which
also surfaces every exited finding, not just a merely `gone` one.

This is the read a running pass calls to cross-reference its own bucket
(blizzard-context:/domain/findings-and-proposals.md).
list.short_help: List ROUTINE's findings under SCOPE — live only, unless --include-gone, which also surfaces every exited finding, not just a merely `gone` one.

reopen.help: Reopen FINDING_IDS, undoing whichever exit or gone fact was newest.
reopen.short_help: Reopen FINDING_IDS, undoing whichever exit or gone fact was newest.

resolve.help: Resolve FINDING_IDS: the work that answers them has landed.
resolve.short_help: Resolve FINDING_IDS: the work that answers them has landed.

wont-fix.help: Withdraw FINDING_IDS as won't-fix — the ground hasn't moved, they don't merit standing.
wont-fix.short_help: Withdraw FINDING_IDS as won't-fix — the ground hasn't moved, they don't merit standing.

finding.help: List or inspect findings, or exit/reopen one or many.
finding.short_help: List or inspect findings, or exit/reopen one or many.

accept.help:
Accept PROPOSAL_ID.

Mints a linked hub work item by default, carrying the proposal's own body unless
--body-file supplies another; --no-work-item declines to mint, and the decline is
recorded rather than left to read as an absent link.

list.help: List every garden proposal, newest first.
list.short_help: List every garden proposal, newest first.

pass.help:
Pass PROPOSAL_ID, recording REASON.

Passing is not a dismissal — it is the note that stops a later run raising the same
response as though it were new.

garden-proposal.help: List, inspect, pass, or accept a garden proposal.
garden-proposal.short_help: List, inspect, pass, or accept a garden proposal.

enable.help: Re-enable a retired GRAPH_ID — restores normal newest-per-name derivation.
enable.short_help: Re-enable a retired GRAPH_ID — restores normal newest-per-name derivation.

follow-latest.help:
Set GRAPH_ID's follow-latest policy: true, false, or inherit (issue #164).

With the policy on, a chunk pinned to this mint re-pins to the newest enabled mint
of the same *name* at its next transition. ``inherit`` (the stored ``null``, and
every mint's default) defers to the hub's own ``follow_latest``.
follow-latest.short_help: Set GRAPH_ID's follow-latest policy: true, false, or inherit (issue #164).

list.help: List every minted graph, newest first — name, graph_id, effective, retired.
list.short_help: List every minted graph, newest first — name, graph_id, effective, retired.

mint.help:
Mint a graph from PATH's YAML definition; PATH may be '-' to read stdin.

A file PATH inlines file references relative to its own directory: a 'prompt'/'prompt_addendum' value only when it
reads as a path, so literal prose stays literal, but every 'artifacts:' value always — one that fails to resolve
fails the load, naming the entry. Stdin has no directory, so it posts verbatim; a 422 renders in full.
mint.short_help: Mint a graph from PATH's YAML definition; PATH may be '-' to read stdin.

retire.help: Retire GRAPH_ID — excludes it from name resolution; in-flight chunks run on.
retire.short_help: Retire GRAPH_ID — excludes it from name resolution; in-flight chunks run on.

show.help: One graph's full reified definition — session pools, nodes, and edges.
show.short_help: One graph's full reified definition — session pools, nodes, and edges.

sync.help:
Reconcile the hub's packaged graphs into its store, minting only what changed.

The deploy verb (issue #146) — graphs live in the store, not on disk, so run it at
the end of every deploy; it is idempotent. The **hub's own** packaged set is what is
reconciled, not this CLI's. Exits non-zero only if a packaged graph failed to load.
sync.short_help: Reconcile the hub's packaged graphs into its store, minting only what changed.

graph.help: Operator verbs over minted graphs: list, inspect, mint, retire, re-enable.
graph.short_help: Operator verbs over minted graphs: list, inspect, mint, retire, re-enable.

host.help:
Become the blizzard-hub daemon: HTTP API + SSE + the embedded web app.

DIRECTORY (positional) and --dir are equivalent — pass one; giving both requires
they agree. Defaults to $BZ_HUB_DIR, then the cwd.
host.short_help: Become the blizzard-hub daemon: HTTP API + SSE + the embedded web app.

init.help:
Scaffold config + data dir + a migrated store under DIRECTORY. Idempotent.

DIRECTORY defaults to $BZ_HUB_DIR, then the cwd.
init.short_help: Scaffold config + data dir + a migrated store under DIRECTORY.

create.help:
Author a fresh item at SOURCE, minting its resting chunk.

--body-file may be '-' to read the body from stdin, so an agent can pipe a composed
spec without shell-quoting a multi-line markdown document.
create.short_help: Author a fresh item at SOURCE, minting its resting chunk.

delete.help: Withdraw the item at TOKEN (e.g. hub:42).

edit.help: Edit the item at TOKEN (e.g. hub:42) in place — only the given fields change.

item.help: Operator verbs over one work item: author, edit, or withdraw it at its source.
item.short_help: Operator verbs over one work item: author, edit, or withdraw it at its source.

login.help:
Log into the hub (issue #96) — opens the browser to the hub's own authorize
endpoint (PKCE, an ephemeral ``127.0.0.1`` loopback redirect) and stores the
resulting session token locally. The CLI never contacts a provider directly.
``--paste`` uses the paste-code fallback for a shell with no reachable loopback
listener; ``--no-browser`` still runs the loopback flow, printing the URL.
login.short_help: Log into the hub (issue #96) — opens the browser to the hub's own authorize endpoint (PKCE, an ephemeral ``127.0.0.1`` loopback redirect) and stores the resulting session token locally.

logout.help:
Log out of the hub (issue #96) — deletes the locally stored session token and
revokes it at the hub, so it stops resolving even if it leaked. A no-op (locally)
if never logged in; the revoke call is best-effort (a hub already unreachable, or
an already-expired session, does not block the local cleanup).
logout.short_help: Log out of the hub (issue #96) — deletes the locally stored session token and revokes it at the hub, so it stops resolving even if it leaked.

migrate.help: Apply pending store migrations, or reverse with --down <rev>.
migrate.short_help: Apply pending store migrations, or reverse with --down <rev>.

answer.help:
Answer an open question (first-write-wins CAS at the hub).

A racing second answer loses and is told who already answered. A pure client of
``POST /api/questions/{id}/answers`` (issue #104).
answer.short_help: Answer an open question (first-write-wins CAS at the hub).

list.help: Every open (unanswered) question across the fleet.
list.short_help: Every open (unanswered) question across the fleet.

question.help: Operator verbs over open questions: list, answer.
question.short_help: Operator verbs over open questions: list, answer.

move.help:
Move CHUNK_ID to POSITION in the ready queue (``0`` is the front).

A client of the single-chunk fractional ``POST /api/queue/position`` (issue #137):
reads the current order, drops CHUNK_ID out of it, clamps POSITION into what's left,
and sends one anchor. 409 when CHUNK_ID is not in the ready list, not the backlog.
move.short_help: Move CHUNK_ID to POSITION in the ready queue (``0`` is the front).

set.help:
Replace the whole ready-queue order with CHUNK_IDS, front to back.

A pure client of ``PUT /api/queue`` — an idempotent whole-order replacement
(issue #104). Every id must be in the ready list, not the backlog (409), and must
not repeat (422); a chunk not named keeps its relative order, appended last.
set.short_help: Replace the whole ready-queue order with CHUNK_IDS, front to back.

show.help: The hub-ordered ready queue, read-only — a client of ``GET /api/queue``.
show.short_help: The hub-ordered ready queue, read-only — a client of ``GET /api/queue``.

queue.help: Operator verbs over the ready queue: show its order, replace it, move one chunk.
queue.short_help: Operator verbs over the ready queue: show its order, replace it, move one chunk.

record-marker.help:
A hub command node's ``run:`` script: record a marker artifact mid-run (#65).

The injected ``BZ_HUB_MARKER_CALLBACK_URL`` already carries this run's chunk, node,
and epoch. Idempotent per marker NAME; authorized by ``BZ_HUB_MARKER_TOKEN``
(issue #230), whose absence is named rather than posted unauthenticated.
record-marker.short_help: A hub command node's ``run:`` script: record a marker artifact mid-run (#65).

rotate-signing-key.help:
Rotate the hub's IdP signing keypair (issue #95) — mints a fresh current key,
demoting the old current to previous; no restart. A no-op error under ``auth.mode = "none"``
(no keypair exists). Human-plane, gated on ``user:manage`` — under ``auth.mode =
"oauth"`` this requires a hub session (``blizzard hub login``, issue #96).
rotate-signing-key.short_help: Rotate the hub's IdP signing keypair (issue #95) — mints a fresh current key, demoting the old current to previous; no restart.

create.help:
Mint a routine named NAME, running GRAPH_NAME with DEFAULT_SCOPE_SLUG's scope.

DEFAULT_SCOPE_SLUG mints a fresh scope if unseen (D4). GRAPH_NAME must resolve to
an enabled graph.
create.short_help: Mint a routine named NAME, running GRAPH_NAME with DEFAULT_SCOPE_SLUG's scope.

edit.help:
Change ROUTINE_ID's graph, default scope, and model/effort defaults; its name
never changes here.
edit.short_help: Change ROUTINE_ID's graph, default scope, and model/effort defaults; its name never changes here.

list.help: List every routine, newest first — routine_id, name, graph, default scope.
list.short_help: List every routine, newest first — routine_id, name, graph, default scope.

run.help:
Mint, ingest, and promote a hub work item from routine NAME, in one act.

NAME is resolved to its routine_id through the routine list (D3).
run.short_help: Mint, ingest, and promote a hub work item from routine NAME, in one act.

show.help: One routine's whole record — name, graph, default scope, model/effort defaults.
show.short_help: One routine's whole record — name, graph, default scope, model/effort defaults.

trend.help:
NAME's finding inflow-against-outflow over --since/--until: per-period created and
per-kind exit counts, the outflow/withdrawn roll-ups, and the introduced-age cut
against --introduced-boundary.
trend.short_help: NAME's finding inflow-against-outflow over --since/--until: per-period created and per-kind exit counts, the outflow/withdrawn roll-ups, and the introduced-age cut against --introduced-boundary.

routine.help: Operator verbs over routines: create, list, inspect, edit.
routine.short_help: Operator verbs over routines: create, list, inspect, edit.

enroll.help:
Mint (or rotate) RUNNER_ID's bearer token; prints the plaintext exactly once.

A thin client of ``POST /runners/{id}/enrollments`` (issue #86a). Re-running
rotates: the old token stops resolving immediately. RUNNER_ID must already be
registered at the hub (404 otherwise).
enroll.short_help: Mint (or rotate) RUNNER_ID's bearer token; prints the plaintext exactly once.

list.help: The fleet registry — every runner with derived liveness + paused state.
list.short_help: The fleet registry — every runner with derived liveness + paused state.

pause.help: Pause a runner — it stops claiming new work; in-flight chunks run on.
pause.short_help: Pause a runner — it stops claiming new work; in-flight chunks run on.

resume.help: Resume a paused runner — it claims work again on its next pull.
resume.short_help: Resume a paused runner — it claims work again on its next pull.

show.help: One runner's derived liveness + paused state, symmetric with ``runner list``.
show.short_help: One runner's derived liveness + paused state, symmetric with ``runner list``.

runner.help: Operator verbs over one runner: identity, liveness, and its pause brake.
runner.short_help: Operator verbs over one runner: identity, liveness, and its pause brake.

create.help:
Mint SLUG, or no-op onto the existing scope of the same slug.

A re-create never overwrites a stored description — ``scope edit`` is the verb that
changes it.
create.short_help: Mint SLUG, or no-op onto the existing scope of the same slug.

edit.help: Change SLUG's stored description in place; never touches its slug.
edit.short_help: Change SLUG's stored description in place; never touches its slug.

list.help: List every scope, newest first — slug, retired, description.
list.short_help: List every scope, newest first — slug, retired, description.

retire.help: Retire SLUG — a reversible brake; in-flight users of it are untouched.
retire.short_help: Retire SLUG — a reversible brake; in-flight users of it are untouched.

scope.help: Operator verbs over scopes: create, list, edit, retire, re-enable.
scope.short_help: Operator verbs over scopes: create, list, edit, retire, re-enable.

status.help: The fleet view: every chunk with its derived status, the runners, and open questions.
status.short_help: The fleet view: every chunk with its derived status, the runners, and open questions.

help: Talk to — or become — the blizzard hub.
short_help: Talk to — or become — the blizzard hub.
